d:
The Bulls defeated the Hornets, 107-105 tonight in Charlotte. Matas Buzelis finished with a team-high 24 points along with 5 rebounds for the Bulls, while Josh Giddey tallied 12 points, 11 rebounds and 7 assists in the game. Brandon Miller recorded 35 points, 4 three pointers and 3 rebounds. The Bulls improve their record to 6-12 with the win, while the Hornets fall to 4-13 for the season.
